query: SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?label ?sci ?links (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?alt;separator="|") AS ?aliases) WHERE { ?item wdt:P171+ wd:Q7380; wdt:P225 ?sci; rdfs:label ?label . FILTER(LANG(?label)="en") FILTER(LCASE(STR(?label))!=LCASE(STR(?sci))) OPTIONAL{?item skos:altLabel ?alt FILTER(LANG(?alt)="en")} OPTIONAL{?item wikibase:sitelinks ?links} } GROUP BY ?item ?label ?sci ?links
